facts.assertion: Alma Estate regeneration has delivered 679 new homes since regeneration began in 2015.
Enfield's current Alma page says the project is now delivering 1,402 homes in total.
The remaining Alma phases are planned to bring forward 723 homes across Phases 2B and 3.
On completion Alma is planned to include 444 affordable homes, including 246 for social rent.
The current Alma scheme page expects overall project completion in summer 2032.
Early demolition works are currently taking place at Alma and construction of council social-rent homes is due to start in September 2026.
The first tranche of Alma social-rent homes is forecast for completion in March 2029.
Dendridge Close is proposed to deliver 27 social-rent homes.
Planning consent for Dendridge Close was granted on 10 April 2026.
The current Dendridge Close page says Enfield aims to start construction in summer 2026.
The Joyce Avenue and Snell's Park regeneration ballot had an 85% turnout and 78.5% voted in favour.
Planning permission for Joyce Avenue and Snell's Park was granted in July 2025.
Hill Partnerships was appointed main contractor for the first Joyce and Snell's phases in March 2026.
Construction of Joyce and Snell's Block A is underway and the first new homes are expected to be handed over in 2028.
Ladderswood is planned to deliver 517 properties in total.
Ladderswood Phase 5 is due to start in spring 2027 and is planned for 21 affordable homes and 45 private-sale homes.
Ladderswood Phase 6 is planned for 46 private flats, 36 private houses and 10 affordable flats.
Meridian Water aims to deliver 10,000 homes and thousands of jobs over the lifetime of the programme.
Meridian One A contains 301 homes and the council says more than 90% are affordable.
Enfield's February 2026 Housing Delivery and Placemaking Plan sets a ten-year site programme for affordable-home delivery, but a programme site is not automatically candidate parcel membership.
